item.title: Mei☆Puru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet Basil
  • 発売日: 2002-01-25
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: めい☆ぷる
  • 英語名: Mei☆Puru

あらすじ

This game tells the story of a family that lost the mother in an accident when the daughter was a young child. The father of the child is a robot technology genius. Time passes and the young girl (Hiiragi) goes everyday to study at school, and someone hires her father to make a maid robot so first he decides to create a prototype and see how it will work in his own house.

item.title: Itsuka no Sora
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet Basil
  • 発売日: 2001-09-07
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いつかの空
  • 英語名: Itsuka no Sora

あらすじ

Our hero is a sophomore college student living by himself. He has a childhood friend that is a girl, but he doesn’t have a real girlfriend. His hope of finding someone special is fading away when his part time job eats up his time. Then he meets Eri, who happens to have lost her memory. The encounter with Eri leads our hero towards his destiny and forces him to search for his true identity…

item.title: Teito no Yuri
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet Basil
  • 発売日: 2000-06-02
  • スコア: 5.74/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 帝都のユリ
  • 英語名: Teito no Yuri

あらすじ

Showa 10th. The “Emperor” reigns for many years while recession continues and natural disasters break out. At the same time the Teito Tokyo faction that seeks reforms grows in power.

All all-girl military unit that vowed to protect the emperor hear a rumor that that the ruler is obstructed and can not rule anymore. They decide to organize a coup d’etat to protect the emperor.

item.title: Rinkaiten ~Critical Point~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet Basil
  • 発売日: 1998-07-24
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (481 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 臨界点 ～クリティカル・ポイント～
  • 英語名: Rinkaiten Critical Point

あらすじ

In the early 21st century, a sudden shortage of food and energy sparked World War III, a massive conflict that saw the deaths of millions and brought the population of Earth to 15% of its prewar level. Years later, an uneasy calm has descended on humanity, although a state of war still technically exists. Four power blocs that share control of the Moon and the earth, each looking for a weakness they can exploit against the others.

  • 日本語名: 放課後はフィアンセ

あらすじ

Tadashi Wakita lost his parents in an accident at an early age, but thanks to the assistance of his uncle Kanno Rotaro, he is a high school student and lives in a house. Uncle dies and leaves a will that nephew must marry one of his three daughters in order to inherit his property and he must do it before the deadline.
